name: vibe-shield

interface.longDescription: Static security scanner and MCP server with 92 rules for AI-generated Next.js, Supabase and TypeScript apps. It checks API routes, auth and webhook verification, database access and MCP and Skill files such as SKILL.md, .cursorrules and mcp.json.
